skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and differentiate various forms of international investment and analyze their impacts on participating countries.
Analyze the components and impact of the international investment environment on investment activities.
Understand the role of multinational corporations in expanding international investment globally and analyze their strategies.
Understand the legal aspects and comply with regulations in international investment.
Develop research and analysis skills to solve specific issues in international investment.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems in international investment.
Work effectively in teams and independently to complete research projects.
Present research findings effectively and engage in discussions.
Manage time effectively to meet deadlines for assignments and presentations.
Develop independent learning skills to continue education and adapt to globalization and the 4th Industrial Revolution.
